say:1:1631115001:1.text: Well now... It's been a long time since someone slept so peacefully!
say:1:1631115001:1.source_cn: 真是难得，好久没见到有人睡得那么香甜了！

say:3:1631115002:0.text: Huh? You know me? Then you must also know I love whispering stories to those wrapped in sweet dreams.
say:3:1631115002:0.source_cn: 咦，你认识我？那你一定知道，我最喜欢向那些被美梦萦绕的...
say:3:1631115002:0.male: Huh? You know me? Then you must also know I love whispering stories to those wrapped in sweet dreams.
say:3:1631115002:0.female: Huh? You know me? Then you must also know I love whispering stories to those wrapped in sweet dreams.

say:4:1631115003:1.text: Let me think... Today I'll secretly share a little story about my good friend, Aurora.
say:4:1631115003:1.source_cn: 我想想……今天就偷偷讲一个我的好朋友奥萝拉的小秘密吧！
say:4:1631115003:1.male: Let me think... Today I'll secretly share a little story about my good friend, Aurora.
say:4:1631115003:1.female: Let me think... Today I'll secretly share a little story about my good friend, Aurora.

say:5:1631115004:1.text: Many know this: the deeper your sleep, the more likely Aurora herself will visit your dreams.
say:5:1631115004:1.source_cn: 许多人都听说过，睡得越香，奥萝拉就越可能亲自造访他们的梦境。
say:5:1631115004:1.male: Many know this: the deeper your sleep, the more likely Aurora herself will visit your dreams.
say:5:1631115004:1.female: Many know this: the deeper your sleep, the more likely Aurora herself will visit your dreams.

say:6:1631115005:1.text: But some people try to cheat, falling asleep drunk! Hmph! Aurora hates the smell of alcohol. Anyone who tries that ends up trapped in dreadful nightmares.
say:6:1631115005:1.source_cn: 可是，有些人竟然故意酗酒入睡！哼，奥萝拉最讨厌酒味儿了...
say:6:1631115005:1.male: But some people try to cheat, falling asleep drunk! Hmph! Aurora hates the smell of alcohol. Anyone who tries that ends up trapped in dreadful nightmares.
say:6:1631115005:1.female: But some people try to cheat, falling asleep drunk! Hmph! Aurora hates the smell of alcohol. Anyone who tries that ends up trapped in dreadful nightmares.

say:7:1631115006:1.text: Remember, true sweet dreams can only be earned through sincere sleep.
say:7:1631115006:1.source_cn: 记住啊，真正的美梦，可是要用真诚的睡眠才能换来的！
say:7:1631115006:1.male: Remember, true sweet dreams can only be earned through sincere sleep.
